title: Triangle Base
description: Also called the waterbomb base. Book folds are valleys, diagonals mountains.

steps.title: Horizontal crease
steps.instruction: Fold edge to edge, then unfold.
tips: Edges exactly on top of each other.

steps.title: Vertical crease
steps.instruction: Fold the other edges together, then unfold.
tips: Both creases cross at the centre.

steps.title: Turn over
tips: Diagonals go in from the back.

steps.title: Turn back
tips: Book folds are valleys from this side.

steps.title: Collapse
steps.instruction: Push the sides in; flatten into a triangle.
tips: Bring the side midpoints down together.
mistakes: Forcing one side before the other.

steps.title: Point up
steps.instruction: Rotate so the closed point is at the top.
tips: Diagrams usually show the waterbomb point up.
mistakes: Turning it over instead of rotating.
steps.check: A triangle with two flaps each side.
